questions.q: Which actor plays Arun Verma, the invisible hero of Mr. India?
questions.why: Anil Kapoor plays the violinist who becomes Mr. India with a device his father made.

questions.q: Which actress plays the journalist Seema in Mr. India?
questions.why: Sridevi plays Seema, the newspaper reporter who falls for Mr. India.

questions.q: Under which colour of light can Mr. India be seen even while invisible?
questions.why: The invisibility fails against red, so red light or red glass reveals him.
Shekhar Kapur directed the 1987 science-fiction hit.

questions.q: Who produced Mr. India under the Narsimha Enterprises banner?
questions.why: Boney and Surinder jointly produced the film.

questions.q: Which star turned down the Mr. India lead after the writers offered it to him?
questions.why: The lead was first written for Rajesh Khanna and then offered to Amitabh Bachchan, who declined.

questions.q: Who was originally set to sing 'Hawa Hawai' for Mr. India?
questions.why: Asha Bhosle was first lined up for the song before the soundtrack was finalised.

questions.q: Mr. India became a hit in which country after a 1990 release?
questions.why: The film was a hit in China after its February 1990 release there.

questions.q: Who composed the music of Mr. India?
questions.why: Laxmikant-Pyarelal composed the songs, with lyrics by Javed Akhtar.

questions.q: Which actor plays Arun's assistant Calendar?
questions.why: Satish Kaushik plays Calendar, Arun's helper in the orphan-filled house.
